color.note: Night is the brand theme and the default. Contrast is an added high-contrast theme (WCAG AAA text, borders on every surface) offered in Settings; it is never a re-tint of Night.

tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: Top of the sky gradient and the letterbox around the play frame on desktop. Canvas fill, not a UI surface.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The ground: play field base and every screen background. All text tokens are checked on it.

tokens.name: sky-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets: game-over card, leaderboard, settings. Text tokens are checked on it.

tokens.name: sky-rise
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for secondary buttons and leaderboard rows on sky-raised.

tokens.name: meadow
tokens.usage: Grass silhouettes along the bottom of the play field. Decorative; never behind text smaller than 24px.

tokens.name: meadow-tip
tokens.usage: Lighter grass blades layered in front of meadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between leaderboard rows and inside panels. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: the secondary button outline and panel edges in Contrast. 3:1 or more on sky and sky-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Moonlight cream. Primary text and numerals on sky, sky-raised and sky-deep.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata and leaderboard ranks on sky and sky-raised.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Firefly amber, the brand colour. Primary button fill, the score numeral, the firefly body; as text it reads on sky, sky-raised and glow-soft.

tokens.name: glow-core
tokens.usage: The hot centre of a firefly and the catch burst. Canvas only.

tokens.name: glow-halo
tokens.usage: Soft halo drawn around a firefly. Off in Contrast, where the firefly gets a solid ink ring instead.

tokens.name: firefly-ring
tokens.usage: Ring drawn around each firefly. Invisible in Night; a solid 3px white ring in Contrast so targets never rely on glow alone.

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind glow text: the player's own leaderboard row, the Best chip.

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a glow fill (the primary button label). Never white.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Better than before: New best, the combo chip, the Swarm bonus. Always paired with words ("New best", "×2 combo"), never colour alone. Text on sky, sky-raised, lime-soft.

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind lime text in the New best chip.

tokens.name: lime-halo
tokens.usage: Halo around a Swarm firefly. Off in Contrast.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: The Frost bonus: its firefly, the frozen moon and timer, the "Frozen" popup. Text on sky, sky-raised and frost-soft (9:1 or more).

tokens.name: frost-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind frost text (the Frozen chip).

tokens.name: frost-halo
tokens.usage: Halo around a Frost firefly, and the field tint and edge vignette while time is frozen.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The last five seconds and errors. Paired with a number or a message, never alone. Text on sky, sky-raised, coral-soft.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind coral text in Notice (error tone).

tokens.name: sky-warm
tokens.usage: Streak heat: the warm glow that rises from the horizon as the combo grows. Field canvas only. Off in Contrast, where the combo chip and pips carry the streak.

tokens.name: sky-aurora
tokens.usage: A faint drifting band across the sky while the combo is at ×3. Field canvas only.

tokens.name: moon
tokens.usage: The moon disc that travels the timer arc.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the play field behind the countdown and the game-over sheet.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3px ink ring with a 2px sky gap. 3:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: One family, Bricolage Grotesque (Google Fonts, variable 200–800, opsz 12–96). In the game build, self-host a Latin subset woff2 under 40 KB; CJK, Thai and Arabic fall back to the system stack.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The game name on the title screen. Once per screen.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: The final score on game over, in glow. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: 3-2-1 before a round, in ink on scrim.

styles.name: score-hud
styles.usage: Live score in the HUD, in glow. Tabular numerals so it never jitters.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Catch the fireflies before they fade.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels over numbers (SCORE, BEST, TIME). The only uppercase style.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Play-field insets add the device safe-area inset on top.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its number.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Leaderboard row padding (vertical), button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones; HUD inset from the frame edge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; gap between stacked buttons and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the score block and the actions on game over.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Title screen vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Leaderboard rows, notices.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets: game over, leaderboard, share card corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips: everything you press is a pill, like a firefly's trail.

shadow.note: Light comes from the fireflies, not from above: glows replace drop shadows. Contrast turns glows off.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest; the Best chip.

tokens.name: glow-lg
tokens.usage: Primary button hovered; the new-best score numeral.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Lifts the game-over sheet off the dimmed field.

size.note: Hit areas and play-field geometry. Values are CSS lengths; the canvas multiplies them by devicePixelRatio.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any button and the minimum firefly hit radius x2.

tokens.name: firefly-start
tokens.usage: Firefly diameter at spawn on a 390px-wide frame; scale with the frame's short side.

tokens.name: firefly-hit-slop
tokens.usage: Extra radius added to a firefly's hit test so a near miss on a fading bug still counts.

tokens.name: frame-max
tokens.usage: Maximum play-frame width on desktop; the frame keeps a 9:16 ratio inside the window.

tokens.name: panel-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the game-over sheet and leaderboard.

duration.note: Motion lengths. Under prefers-reduced-motion, decorative motion drops to 0ms; the firefly shrink, freeze and swarm timings are gameplay and stay.

tokens.name: dur-tap
tokens.usage: Button press scale (0.96) and the firefly catch flash.

tokens.name: dur-burst
tokens.usage: Catch burst: firefly pops to 1.4x and fades into sparks.

tokens.name: dur-sheet
tokens.usage: Game-over sheet rises from the meadow.

tokens.name: dur-count
tokens.usage: Each step of the 3-2-1 countdown.

tokens.name: dur-life
tokens.usage: A firefly's starting lifetime from spawn to gone in Dusk; shortens to 850ms by the end of Midnight (see Gameplay).

tokens.name: dur-freeze
tokens.usage: How long a Frost catch stops the clock and the fireflies' fading.

tokens.name: dur-swarm
tokens.usage: The window in which a Swarm catch releases its six quick fireflies.

tokens.name: dur-float
tokens.usage: Score popups (+1, +2, +5, Frozen) rising and fading from the catch point.

tokens.name: dur-phase
tokens.usage: The phase banner (Night falls, Midnight) fading in and out.

tokens.name: dur-title
tokens.usage: The title intro: Glow rises, then catch lights up letter by letter.

tokens.name: dur-streak
tokens.usage: The combo clock: time allowed between catches before the streak is lost. Shortens to 2200ms at full pace.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: the sheet, rows, the countdown numeral.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Small overshoot: catch burst, score bump, New best chip.

tokens.name: ease-fade
tokens.usage: A firefly shrinking: slow at first, then gone.

tokens.name: z-field
tokens.usage: The canvas.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: Score, timer, pause.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind countdown and sheets.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Game over, leaderboard, settings.

tokens.name: z-notice
tokens.usage: Offline and error notices.
